question:
An elderly patient with diabetes is very drowsy, has a blood glucose of 40 mmol/L and severe dehydration without ketones. The nurse should:

मधुमेह वाला वृद्ध रोगी बहुत तंद्रालु है, रक्त ग्लूकोज़ 40 mmol/L है और बिना कीटोन के गंभीर निर्जलीकरण है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Give isotonic fluids and insulin as ordered with close monitoring
आदेश अनुसार समपरासारी तरल और इंसुलिन दें तथा निकट निगरानी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Hyperosmolar hyperglycaemic state needs careful fluid replacement and insulin with monitoring

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Restrict fluids
तरल रोकें: Fluid restriction worsens the dehydration

C — Give oral glucose
मुँह से ग्लूकोज़ दें: More glucose raises the level further

D — Give a large dose of diuretic
बड़ी मात्रा में मूत्रवर्धक दें: A diuretic worsens dehydration

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Correct dehydration slowly, because rapid changes can cause cerebral oedema
option_1:
Give isotonic fluids and insulin as ordered with close monitoring
आदेश अनुसार समपरासारी तरल और इंसुलिन दें तथा निकट निगरानी करें
option_4:
Give a large dose of diuretic
बड़ी मात्रा में मूत्रवर्धक दें

question:
A patient has a chest drain after a pleural effusion. The nurse should:

फुफ्फुसीय बहाव के बाद रोगी को छाती की नली लगी है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Keep the drain below chest level and check for swinging and bubbling
नली को छाती के स्तर से नीचे रखें और उसके झूलने तथा बुलबुले की जाँच करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The drain stays below chest level so that fluid and air drain and do not flow back

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Lift the drain and walk with it held high
नली उठाकर ऊँची पकड़कर चलें: Holding it high causes fluid to flow back

B — Raise the drain above the chest
नली को छाती के ऊपर उठाएँ: Raising the drain allows backflow into the chest

C — Clamp the tube during transport without orders
बिना आदेश के ले जाते समय नली को क्लैंप करें: Clamping without orders can cause a tension pneumothorax

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report a sudden stop of swinging or continuous bubbling, as these suggest a blocked tube or an air leak
option_1:
Lift the drain and walk with it held high
नली उठाकर ऊँची पकड़कर चलें
option_2:
Raise the drain above the chest
नली को छाती के ऊपर उठाएँ
option_3:
Clamp the tube during transport without orders
बिना आदेश के ले जाते समय नली को क्लैंप करें
option_4:
Keep the drain below chest level and check for swinging and bubbling
नली को छाती के स्तर से नीचे रखें और उसके झूलने तथा बुलबुले की जाँच करें

question:
A patient with advanced chronic kidney disease is usually advised to restrict:

उन्नत दीर्घकालिक गुर्दा रोग वाले रोगी को सामान्यतः किसकी मात्रा सीमित करने की सलाह दी जाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Sodium, potassium and protein as prescribed
आदेश अनुसार सोडियम, पोटेशियम और प्रोटीन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Sodium, potassium and protein are restricted as ordered to reduce the load on the kidneys

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — All carbohydrates
सभी कार्बोहाइड्रेट: Carbohydrates are needed for energy

B — Only water
केवल पानी: Water alone is not the only restriction

D — Vitamin C only
केवल विटामिन C: Vitamin C is not the main restriction

⚠️ Exam Trap: Separate the deficiency disease from its dietary source - exams mix the two.

💎 PNC Pearl: A dietitian helps plan safe meals that keep electrolytes within range
option_3:
Sodium, potassium and protein as prescribed
आदेश अनुसार सोडियम, पोटेशियम और प्रोटीन

question:
A patient with Parkinson's disease has a shuffling gait and tremors. The nurse should:

पार्किंसन रोग वाले रोगी की चाल लड़खड़ाती है और कंपन है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Assist with walking and remove fall hazards from the room
चलने में सहायता करें और कमरे से गिरने के खतरे हटाएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Assistance with walking and a safe environment prevent falls

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Encourage fast walking alone
अकेले तेज़ चलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें: Fast walking alone raises the risk of falls

C — Keep the room dim and cluttered
कमरे को धुँधला और बिखरा रखें: Dim, cluttered rooms increase falls

D — Withhold all anti-parkinson drugs
सभी पार्किंसन-रोधी दवाएँ रोक दें: Withholding drugs worsens symptoms

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Give antiparkinson drugs on time, because sudden gaps can cause severe rigidity
option_1:
Assist with walking and remove fall hazards from the room
चलने में सहायता करें और कमरे से गिरने के खतरे हटाएँ
option_2:
Encourage fast walking alone
अकेले तेज़ चलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें
option_3:
Keep the room dim and cluttered
कमरे को धुँधला और बिखरा रखें
option_4:
Withhold all anti-parkinson drugs
सभी पार्किंसन-रोधी दवाएँ रोक दें

question:
A patient with cirrhosis has a distended abdomen and difficulty breathing. The nurse should:

सिरोसिस वाले रोगी का पेट फूला है और उसे साँस लेने में कठिनाई है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Measure abdominal girth daily, restrict sodium as ordered and position for comfort
प्रतिदिन पेट की परिधि मापें, आदेश अनुसार सोडियम सीमित करें और आरामदायक स्थिति दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Daily girth, sodium restriction and comfortable positioning improve breathing and track ascites

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Lay the patient flat
रोगी को सीधा लिटाएँ: Lying flat worsens breathlessness

C — Ignore the abdominal swelling
पेट की सूजन को अनदेखा करें: Ascites must be assessed and managed

D — Give a high-salt diet
अधिक नमक वाला आहार दें: Salt worsens fluid retention

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for confusion, as it may signal hepatic encephalopathy
option_1:
Measure abdominal girth daily, restrict sodium as ordered and position for comfort
प्रतिदिन पेट की परिधि मापें, आदेश अनुसार सोडियम सीमित करें और आरामदायक स्थिति दें
option_2:
Lay the patient flat
रोगी को सीधा लिटाएँ
option_3:
Ignore the abdominal swelling
पेट की सूजन को अनदेखा करें
option_4:
Give a high-salt diet
अधिक नमक वाला आहार दें

question:
A patient with painful rheumatoid arthritis should be taught to:

दर्दभरे रूमेटॉइड आर्थराइटिस वाले रोगी को क्या सिखाया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Balance rest with gentle range-of-motion exercise
आराम और हल्के गति-अभ्यास में संतुलन रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Rest during flares and gentle range-of-motion exercise between flares protect joint function

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Avoid all movement of the joints
जोड़ों की सारी गति से बचें: Complete immobility causes stiffness

C — Exercise vigorously during a flare
भड़काव के दौरान ज़ोरदार व्यायाम करें: Vigorous exercise during a flare increases damage

D — Apply heat to hot swollen joints during a flare
भड़काव में गर्म सूजे जोड़ों पर गर्मी लगाएँ: Heat on an acutely hot joint can increase inflammation

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Joint protection includes pacing activity and using larger joints for lifting
option_1:
Avoid all movement of the joints
जोड़ों की सारी गति से बचें
option_2:
Balance rest with gentle range-of-motion exercise
आराम और हल्के गति-अभ्यास में संतुलन रखें
option_3:
Exercise vigorously during a flare
भड़काव के दौरान ज़ोरदार व्यायाम करें
option_4:
Apply heat to hot swollen joints during a flare
भड़काव में गर्म सूजे जोड़ों पर गर्मी लगाएँ

question:
After a total hip replacement, the nurse should teach the patient to avoid:

कुल कूल्हा प्रत्यारोपण के बाद नर्स को रोगी को किससे बचने की सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Bending the hip beyond 90 degrees and crossing the legs
कूल्हे को 90 डिग्री से अधिक मोड़ना और पैर क्रॉस करना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Excessive hip flexion and crossing the legs can dislocate the new joint

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Sleeping with a pillow between the knees
घुटनों के बीच तकिया रखकर सोना: A pillow between the knees helps keep the hip aligned

B — Using a raised toilet seat
ऊँची शौचालय सीट का उपयोग: A raised seat protects the hip

C — Walking with a walker
वॉकर से चलना: A walker assists safe mobility

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Teach these precautions clearly before discharge, because a dislocation needs urgent care
option_1:
Sleeping with a pillow between the knees
घुटनों के बीच तकिया रखकर सोना
option_2:
Using a raised toilet seat
ऊँची शौचालय सीट का उपयोग
option_4:
Bending the hip beyond 90 degrees and crossing the legs
कूल्हे को 90 डिग्री से अधिक मोड़ना और पैर क्रॉस करना

question:
A patient with suspected bacterial meningitis has fever and neck stiffness. The nurse should:

जीवाणु मेनिन्जाइटिस के संदेह वाले रोगी को बुखार और गर्दन में अकड़न है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Use the isolation precautions advised and give antibiotics as ordered promptly
सलाहित अलगाव सावधानियाँ अपनाएँ और आदेश अनुसार शीघ्र एंटीबायोटिक दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Isolation precautions and prompt antibiotics are essential in suspected meningococcal meningitis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Delay antibiotics until tests return
परीक्षण आने तक एंटीबायोटिक में देरी करें: Delay is dangerous, because early antibiotics save lives

C — Share the patient's utensils
रोगी के बर्तन साझा करें: Sharing utensils spreads infection

D — Keep the room lights bright all night
रातभर कमरे की रोशनी तेज़ रखें: Bright light worsens headache and discomfort

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Follow local policy for droplet precautions and check who needs preventive treatment
option_1:
Delay antibiotics until tests return
परीक्षण आने तक एंटीबायोटिक में देरी करें

Use the isolation precautions advised and give antibiotics as ordered promptly
सलाहित अलगाव सावधानियाँ अपनाएँ और आदेश अनुसार शीघ्र एंटीबायोटिक दें
option_3:
Share the patient's utensils
रोगी के बर्तन साझा करें
option_4:
Keep the room lights bright all night

question:
After lung surgery, the nurse should encourage the patient to:

फेफड़े की सर्जरी के बाद नर्स को रोगी को किस बात के लिए प्रोत्साहित करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Do deep breathing and support the wound when coughing
गहरी श्वास लें और खाँसते समय घाव को सहारा दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Deep breathing and wound support when coughing clear secretions and reduce complications

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Avoid all pain relief so as to stay alert
सतर्क रहने के लिए सारी दर्द-राहत छोड़ें: Poor pain control prevents deep breathing

C — Start heavy lifting at once
तुरंत भारी वज़न उठाना शुरू करें: Heavy lifting too early strains the incision

D — Lie still and avoid all breathing exercises
स्थिर लेटे रहें और सारे श्वास-अभ्यास छोड़ें: Stillness leads to chest infection and collapse of lung tissue

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Adequate analgesia before breathing exercises improves their effect
option_1:
Do deep breathing and support the wound when coughing
गहरी श्वास लें और खाँसते समय घाव को सहारा दें

Avoid all pain relief so as to stay alert
सतर्क रहने के लिए सारी दर्द-राहत छोड़ें

Lie still and avoid all breathing exercises

question:
A patient with a spinal cord injury develops a sudden severe headache and a very high blood pressure. The nurse should first:

रीढ़ की हड्डी की चोट वाले रोगी को अचानक तेज़ सिरदर्द और बहुत उच्च रक्तचाप होता है। नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Sit the patient up and look for a full bladder or other trigger
रोगी को सीधा बैठाएँ और भरे मूत्राशय या अन्य कारण की तलाश करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Autonomic dysreflexia is managed by sitting the patient up and removing the trigger, often a full bladder

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignore it as normal
इसे सामान्य मानकर अनदेखा करें: This is a medical emergency, not a normal event

B — Lay the patient flat
रोगी को सीधा लिटाएँ: Lying flat raises the blood pressure further

C — Give a hot drink
गर्म पेय दें: A hot drink is not the treatment

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the bladder and bowel first, because these are the commonest triggers above the level of the injury
option_1:
Ignore it as normal
इसे सामान्य मानकर अनदेखा करें

Lay the patient flat

question:
A patient with a peptic ulcer caused by Helicobacter pylori should be taught to:

हेलिकोबैक्टर पाइलोरी के कारण पेप्टिक अल्सर वाले रोगी को क्या सिखाया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Complete the full course of medicines and avoid irritants such as alcohol
पूरी दवा का कोर्स पूरा करें और शराब जैसे उत्तेजक पदार्थों से बचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Completing the medicine course eradicates the organism, and irritants are avoided

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Skip meals to rest the stomach
पेट को आराम देने के लिए भोजन छोड़ें: Regular small meals are better than skipping meals

B — Take painkillers like aspirin freely
एस्पिरिन जैसे दर्दनाशक खुलकर लें: Aspirin and similar drugs can worsen ulcers

C — Stop medicines once the pain goes
दर्द चले जाने पर दवा बंद कर दें: Stopping early allows relapse and resistance

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for signs of bleeding such as black stools or vomiting blood

Skip meals to rest the stomach
पेट को आराम देने के लिए भोजन छोड़ें

question:
A patient has a serum potassium of 7.0 mmol/L with tall peaked T waves. The nurse should:

रोगी का सीरम पोटैशियम 7.0 mmol/L है और ECG में ऊँची नुकीली T तरंगें हैं। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Report at once and prepare the ordered treatment, holding potassium sources
तुरंत सूचना दें, आदेशित उपचार की तैयारी करें और पोटैशियम स्रोत रोकें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Severe hyperkalaemia threatens the heart, so it is reported at once and treated as ordered with potassium withheld

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignore it if the patient feels well
रोगी ठीक लगे तो अनदेखा करें: This can cause a fatal arrhythmia even without symptoms

B — Give a high-potassium diet
अधिक पोटैशियम वाला आहार दें: A high-potassium diet worsens the level

D — Give a potassium supplement
पोटैशियम की खुराक दें: More potassium is dangerous

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Monitor the heart rhythm closely, because hyperkalaemia can stop the heart
option_1:
Ignore it if the patient feels well
रोगी ठीक लगे तो अनदेखा करें

Give a high-potassium diet

option_4:
Give a potassium supplement
पोटैशियम की खुराक दें

question:
After cataract surgery, the nurse should advise the patient to:

मोतियाबिंद की सर्जरी के बाद नर्स को रोगी को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Avoid bending, heavy lifting and rubbing the eye
झुकने, भारी वज़न उठाने और आँख मलने से बचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Avoiding bending, straining and rubbing protects the healing eye

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Splash water into the eye
आँख में पानी डालें: Water may introduce infection

C — Sleep on the operated side
ऑपरेशन वाली तरफ़ सोएँ: Sleeping on the operated side raises pressure on the eye

D — Rub the eye to relieve itching
खुजली के लिए आँख मलें: Rubbing can dislodge the healing tissue

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report sudden severe pain or a marked drop in vision at once

Splash water into the eye
आँख में पानी डालें
option_2:
Avoid bending, heavy lifting and rubbing the eye

option_3:
Sleep on the operated side

question:
A patient with nephrotic syndrome typically has:

नेफ्रोटिक सिंड्रोम वाले रोगी में सामान्यतः क्या होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Protein in the urine, low blood protein and generalised oedema
मूत्र में प्रोटीन, रक्त में कम प्रोटीन और पूरे शरीर में सूजन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Nephrotic syndrome shows heavy protein loss, low blood protein and oedema

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Low urine protein and dehydration
कम मूत्र प्रोटीन और निर्जलीकरण: Urine protein is high, not low

B — Blood in the urine and no oedema
मूत्र में रक्त और सूजन नहीं: Blood in the urine with no oedema suggests a different picture

D — Normal urine with high blood protein
सामान्य मूत्र और अधिक रक्त प्रोटीन: Blood protein is low, not high

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Weigh the patient daily and watch for infection, because protein loss lowers immunity
option_1:
Low urine protein and dehydration
कम मूत्र प्रोटीन और निर्जलीकरण
option_2:
Blood in the urine and no oedema
मूत्र में रक्त और सूजन नहीं
option_3:
Protein in the urine, low blood protein and generalised oedema
मूत्र में प्रोटीन, रक्त में कम प्रोटीन और पूरे शरीर में सूजन
option_4:
Normal urine with high blood protein
सामान्य मूत्र और अधिक रक्त प्रोटीन

question:
The difference between the apical and radial pulse rates is called the:

शीर्ष और रेडियल नाड़ी दर के अंतर को क्या कहा जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Pulse deficit
नाड़ी घाटा

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The difference between the apical and radial pulse rates is the pulse deficit

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Pulse pressure
नाड़ी दाब: Pulse pressure is the difference between systolic and diastolic pressures

C — Pulse rhythm
नाड़ी लय: Pulse rhythm describes the pattern of beats

D — Stroke volume
आघात मात्रा: Stroke volume is the blood pumped in one beat

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: A pulse deficit is common in atrial fibrillation and needs two nurses to measure at the same time

question:
While giving a bed bath, the nurse should:

बिस्तर पर स्नान कराते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Expose only one part at a time and keep the patient warm
एक बार में केवल एक भाग खोलें और रोगी को गर्म रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Exposing one part at a time and keeping the patient warm preserves privacy and comfort

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Skip washing the skin folds
त्वचा की तहें धोना छोड़ दें: Skin folds need careful cleaning to prevent infection

B — Expose the whole body at once
पूरा शरीर एक साथ खोल दें: Full exposure causes chilling and loss of privacy

C — Use very hot water
बहुत गर्म पानी का उपयोग करें: Very hot water can burn the skin

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Observe the skin for redness and breaks during the bath
option_1:
Skip washing the skin folds
त्वचा की तहें धोना छोड़ दें
option_2:
Expose the whole body at once
पूरा शरीर एक साथ खोल दें
option_3:
Use very hot water
बहुत गर्म पानी का उपयोग करें
option_4:
Expose only one part at a time and keep the patient warm
एक बार में केवल एक भाग खोलें और रोगी को गर्म रखें

question:
To give 1000 mL of fluid over 8 hours using a set that delivers 20 drops per mL, the rate is about:

20 बूँद प्रति mL देने वाले सेट से 1000 mL तरल 8 घंटे में देने की दर लगभग कितनी होगी:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 42 drops per minute
42 बूँद प्रति मिनट

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Drops per minute equals volume times drop factor divided by time in minutes, giving about 42

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 21 drops per minute
21 बूँद प्रति मिनट: 21 ignores the drop factor

C — 84 drops per minute
84 बूँद प्रति मिनट: 84 doubles the correct answer

D — 14 drops per minute
14 बूँद प्रति मिनट: 14 is too low

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the drip rate regularly, because too fast or too slow a rate can harm the patient
option_1:
21 drops per minute
21 बूँद प्रति मिनट
option_2:
42 drops per minute

84 drops per minute
84 बूँद प्रति मिनट

14 drops per minute
14 बूँद प्रति मिनट

question:
A patient develops fever, chills and back pain during a blood transfusion. The nurse should first:

रक्त आधान के दौरान रोगी को बुखार, ठंड लगना और पीठ दर्द होता है। नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Stop the transfusion and start normal saline with a new set
आधान रोकें और नए सेट से सामान्य सलाइन शुरू करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Stop the transfusion at once and keep the vein open with normal saline through a new set

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give the rest of the unit quickly
शेष यूनिट शीघ्र दें: Completing the unit is dangerous

B — Ignore the symptoms
लक्षणों को अनदेखा करें: Ignoring a reaction can be fatal

D — Increase the transfusion rate
आधान की गति बढ़ाएँ: Increasing the rate worsens the reaction

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report the reaction, save the unit and send samples, because this guides safe future transfusion
option_1:
Give the rest of the unit quickly
शेष यूनिट शीघ्र दें
option_3:
Stop the transfusion and start normal saline with a new set
आधान रोकें और नए सेट से सामान्य सलाइन शुरू करें
option_4:
Increase the transfusion rate
आधान की गति बढ़ाएँ

question:
While giving a cleansing enema, the nurse should:

सफ़ाई वाला एनीमा देते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Position the patient on the left side and give the fluid slowly
रोगी को बाईं करवट दिलाएँ और तरल धीरे-धीरे दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Left-side positioning and a slow flow help the fluid reach and soften stool comfortably

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Place the container below the hips
पात्र को कूल्हों से नीचे रखें: The container is held above the hips so that fluid flows in

B — Give the fluid as fast as possible
तरल जितनी जल्दी हो सके दें: A fast flow causes cramps

D — Use very hot solution
बहुत गर्म घोल का उपयोग करें: A hot solution can burn the bowel lining

⚠️ Exam Trap: Remember that delegation transfers the task but never the accountability.

💎 PNC Pearl: Stop the enema if the patient complains of severe pain or cramps
option_1:
Place the container below the hips
पात्र को कूल्हों से नीचे रखें
option_2:
Give the fluid as fast as possible
तरल जितनी जल्दी हो सके दें
option_3:
Position the patient on the left side and give the fluid slowly
रोगी को बाईं करवट दिलाएँ और तरल धीरे-धीरे दें
option_4:
Use very hot solution
बहुत गर्म घोल का उपयोग करें

question:
While oxygen is in use, the nurse must ensure:

ऑक्सीजन के उपयोग के दौरान नर्स को क्या सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. No smoking or open flames nearby
आसपास धूम्रपान या खुली आग न हो

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Oxygen supports combustion, so smoking and open flames are prohibited

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — No check is needed on the tubing
नली की जाँच की आवश्यकता नहीं: The tubing and connections must be checked

B — Oil is applied to the cylinder parts
सिलेंडर के भागों पर तेल लगाया जाए: Oil and grease near oxygen can ignite

C — The cylinder is kept lying down
सिलेंडर को लिटाया जाए: A cylinder is best kept upright and secured

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Secure the cylinder and post a no-smoking sign to prevent fires
option_1:
No check is needed on the tubing
नली की जाँच की आवश्यकता नहीं

Oil is applied to the cylinder parts

option_3:
The cylinder is kept lying down
सिलेंडर को लिटाया जाए
option_4:
No smoking or open flames nearby

question:
On a patient's admission, the nurse should first:

रोगी के भर्ती होने पर नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Orient the patient, check identity and record baseline observations
रोगी को परिचय कराएँ, पहचान जाँचें और आधारभूत जीवन-चिह्न दर्ज करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Orienting the patient, confirming identity and recording baseline observations start safe care

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give all medicines without checking
बिना जाँच सारी दवाएँ दें: Medicines need proper checks

B — Leave the patient alone at once
रोगी को तुरंत अकेला छोड़ दें: Leaving a new patient alone causes anxiety and misses needs

D — Skip recording the history
इतिहास दर्ज करना छोड़ दें: The history guides the care plan

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Good orientation reduces anxiety and improves cooperation in treatment
option_1:
Give all medicines without checking
बिना जाँच सारी दवाएँ दें
option_2:
Leave the patient alone at once
रोगी को तुरंत अकेला छोड़ दें
option_3:
Orient the patient, check identity and record baseline observations
रोगी को परिचय कराएँ, पहचान जाँचें और आधारभूत जीवन-चिह्न दर्ज करें
option_4:
Skip recording the history
इतिहास दर्ज करना छोड़ दें

question:
When putting on sterile gloves, the nurse must:

बंध्य दस्ताने पहनते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Touch only the inside of the first glove with the bare hand
पहले दस्ताने के केवल भीतरी भाग को नंगे हाथ से छुएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Only the inside of the glove is touched with the bare hand to keep the outside sterile

A — Touch the outside of the glove with the bare hand
दस्ताने के बाहरी भाग को नंगे हाथ से छुएँ: Touching the outside with a bare hand contaminates it

C — Let the gloves touch the uniform
दस्ताने को यूनिफ़ॉर्म से छूने दें: Contact with clothing contaminates the gloves

D — Blow into the gloves to open them
दस्ताने खोलने के लिए उनमें फूँक मारें: Blowing contaminates the gloves

question:
The nurse should teach a patient to use a numerical pain scale to:

नर्स को रोगी को संख्यात्मक दर्द मापनी का उपयोग करना क्यों सिखाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Describe pain intensity so treatment can be measured
दर्द की तीव्रता बताने के लिए ताकि उपचार का मूल्यांकन हो सके

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A pain scale quantifies pain so that relief can be assessed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Avoid all pain medicines
सारी दर्द की दवा से बचने के लिए: The scale guides, not avoids, pain relief

C — Replace all nursing assessment
सारे नर्सिंग आकलन को बदलने के लिए: It supplements, not replaces, assessment

D — Hide the pain from the team
टीम से दर्द छिपाने के लिए: Pain should be reported, not hidden

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Reassess pain after each intervention to confirm that relief has been achieved
option_1:
Describe pain intensity so treatment can be measured
दर्द की तीव्रता बताने के लिए ताकि उपचार का मूल्यांकन हो सके
option_2:
Avoid all pain medicines

question:
A pregnant woman with anaemia should be advised to take:

एनीमिया वाली गर्भवती महिला को क्या लेने की सलाह दी जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Iron and folic acid supplements with a vitamin C rich diet
आयरन और फोलिक एसिड की खुराक के साथ विटामिन C युक्त आहार

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Iron and folic acid with vitamin C improve haemoglobin in pregnancy

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — No supplements
कोई पूरक नहीं: Supplements are essential

C — Only calcium tablets
केवल कैल्शियम की गोलियाँ: Calcium alone does not treat anaemia

D — Tea with every meal
हर भोजन के साथ चाय: Tea reduces iron absorption

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Untreated anaemia raises the risk of complications during delivery, so regular check-ups matter
option_2:
Iron and folic acid supplements with a vitamin C rich diet
आयरन और फोलिक एसिड की खुराक के साथ विटामिन C युक्त आहार
option_4:
Tea with every meal
हर भोजन के साथ चाय

question:
A woman in labour is fully dilated and feels a strong urge to push. This indicates which stage of labour?

प्रसव में महिला का गर्भाशय पूरी तरह खुला है और उसे ज़ोर से धक्का देने की तीव्र इच्छा है। यह प्रसव की कौन-सी अवस्था है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Second stage of labour
प्रसव की दूसरी अवस्था

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Full dilatation with the urge to push marks the second stage, when the baby is born

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — First stage of labour
प्रसव की पहली अवस्था: The first stage is from the onset of labour to full dilatation

B — Fourth stage of labour
प्रसव की चौथी अवस्था: The fourth stage is the first hour after delivery

C — Third stage of labour
प्रसव की तीसरी अवस्था: The third stage is the delivery of the placenta

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Guide pushing with contractions and support the perineum, then check the baby at once
option_1:
First stage of labour
प्रसव की पहली अवस्था
option_2:
Fourth stage of labour
प्रसव की चौथी अवस्था
option_3:
Third stage of labour
प्रसव की तीसरी अवस्था
option_4:
Second stage of labour
प्रसव की दूसरी अवस्था

question:
A normal newborn should ideally be put to the breast:

एक सामान्य नवजात को आदर्श रूप से स्तनपान कब शुरू कराया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Within the first hour of birth
जन्म के पहले एक घंटे के भीतर

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Early initiation within the first hour supports bonding and milk production

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only on the second day
केवल दूसरे दिन: Waiting until the second day reduces early feeding benefits

B — After 12 hours
12 घंटे बाद: Waiting 12 hours delays valuable colostrum

D — After 24 hours
24 घंटे बाद: 24 hours is far too late

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Colostrum provides protective antibodies, so early feeding is important
option_1:
Only on the second day
केवल दूसरे दिन
option_3:
Within the first hour of birth
जन्म के पहले एक घंटे के भीतर

question:
After an episiotomy, the nurse should teach the woman to:

एपिसियोटॉमी के बाद नर्स को महिला को क्या सिखाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Keep the area clean and dry and change pads often
क्षेत्र को साफ़ और सूखा रखें और बार-बार पैड बदलें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Cleanliness, dryness and frequent pad changes prevent infection and aid healing

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Sit for long periods without moving
बिना हिले लंबे समय तक बैठें: Prolonged sitting adds pressure on the stitches

B — Ignore increased pain
बढ़ते दर्द को अनदेखा करें: Increasing pain may mean infection and must be reported

D — Avoid washing the area
क्षेत्र को धोने से बचें: The area must be kept clean

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Teach cleaning from front to back to avoid contamination from the bowel
option_1:
Sit for long periods without moving
बिना हिले लंबे समय तक बैठें

Ignore increased pain
बढ़ते दर्द को अनदेखा करें
option_3:
Keep the area clean and dry and change pads often
क्षेत्र को साफ़ और सूखा रखें और बार-बार पैड बदलें
option_4:
Avoid washing the area
क्षेत्र को धोने से बचें

question:
A woman with gestational diabetes should be advised to:

गर्भावधि मधुमेह वाली महिला को क्या सलाह दी जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Follow the prescribed diet, monitor glucose and keep antenatal visits
निर्धारित आहार अपनाएँ, ग्लूकोज़ की निगरानी करें और प्रसवपूर्व जाँच जारी रखें

सारी प्रसवपूर्व जाँच छोड़ दें: Skipping visits misses complications

खुलकर मिठाई खाएँ: Sweets raise the glucose level

एक सामान्य रीडिंग के बाद सारी निगरानी बंद करें: Monitoring must continue because the level can rise again

💎 PNC Pearl: Well-controlled gestational diabetes reduces risks for both mother and baby

सारी प्रसवपूर्व जाँच छोड़ दें

Stop all monitoring after one normal reading

question:
A newborn is not breathing well at birth. The nurse should first:

जन्म के समय नवजात ठीक से साँस नहीं ले रहा है। नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Dry, warm and position the baby, then clear the airway if needed
शिशु को सुखाएँ, गर्म रखें और सही स्थिति दें, ज़रूरत हो तो वायुमार्ग साफ़ करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Drying, warming, positioning and clearing the airway are the first steps in newborn resuscitation

🔍 Key Clues: newborn

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Feed the baby first
पहले शिशु को दूध पिलाएँ: Feeding is unsafe before breathing is established

B — Give the baby a bath at once
शिशु को तुरंत नहलाएँ: A bath delays essential care and causes hypothermia

C — Delay any action for ten minutes
दस मिनट तक कोई कार्रवाई न करें: Delay is dangerous, as the baby needs help at once

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Follow the newborn resuscitation protocol and reassess breathing and heart rate continuously
option_1:
Feed the baby first
पहले शिशु को दूध पिलाएँ
option_2:
Give the baby a bath at once
शिशु को तुरंत नहलाएँ
option_3:
Delay any action for ten minutes
दस मिनट तक कोई कार्रवाई न करें
option_4:
Dry, warm and position the baby, then clear the airway if needed
शिशु को सुखाएँ, गर्म रखें और सही स्थिति दें, ज़रूरत हो तो वायुमार्ग साफ़ करें

question:
Kangaroo mother care for a low birth weight baby means:

कम जन्म-भार वाले शिशु के लिए कंगारू मदर केयर का अर्थ क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Skin-to-skin contact with the mother plus frequent breastfeeding
माँ के साथ त्वचा-से-त्वचा संपर्क और बार-बार स्तनपान

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Kangaroo care uses skin-to-skin contact with frequent breastfeeding to keep the baby warm and thriving

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Keeping the baby in a separate room
शिशु को अलग कमरे में रखना: Separation prevents warmth and bonding

C — Avoiding all contact with the mother
माँ से सारा संपर्क बचाना: Avoiding contact defeats the purpose

D — Feeding only with a bottle
केवल बोतल से दूध पिलाना: Breastfeeding, not bottles, is preferred

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Kangaroo care stabilises temperature, improves feeding and reduces infection in small babies
option_1:
Skin-to-skin contact with the mother plus frequent breastfeeding
माँ के साथ त्वचा-से-त्वचा संपर्क और बार-बार स्तनपान
option_2:
Keeping the baby in a separate room
शिशु को अलग कमरे में रखना
option_3:
Avoiding all contact with the mother
माँ से सारा संपर्क बचाना
option_4:
Feeding only with a bottle
केवल बोतल से दूध पिलाना

question:
A patient on morphine should be watched mainly for:

मॉर्फिन पर रोगी की मुख्य रूप से किस चीज़ के लिए निगरानी की जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Slow breathing and constipation
धीमी श्वास और कब्ज़

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Morphine can depress breathing and cause constipation

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — High blood sugar
उच्च रक्त शर्करा: High blood sugar is linked to steroids

C — Hair loss
बालों का झड़ना: Hair loss is linked to chemotherapy

D — Tooth decay
दाँतों का क्षय: Tooth decay is not a typical opioid effect

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Monitor the respiratory rate and give stool softeners as ordered to prevent constipation
option_1:
Slow breathing and constipation
धीमी श्वास और कब्ज़

question:
Metformin should be used with caution or stopped in a patient with:

मेटफ़ॉर्मिन किस रोगी में सावधानी से या बंद करके उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Severe kidney impairment
गंभीर गुर्दा क्षति

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Metformin is used with caution in kidney impairment because of the risk of lactic acidosis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Mild headache
हल्का सिरदर्द: A mild headache does not affect its use

C — Mild common cold
हल्की सर्दी: A common cold does not require stopping it

D — A single high blood glucose
एक बार उच्च रक्त ग्लूकोज़: A single high reading is not a reason to stop

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Metformin is often held before scans with contrast dye, as ordered
option_4:
A single high blood glucose
एक बार उच्च रक्त ग्लूकोज़

question:
A beta blocker should be given with caution in a patient with:

बीटा ब्लॉकर किस रोगी में सावधानी से देना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Asthma
दमा

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Beta blockers can cause bronchospasm, so they are used with caution in asthma

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Mild rash
हल्का दाने: A mild rash is unrelated

B — Mild headache
हल्का सिरदर्द: A mild headache is not a contraindication

C — Short-sightedness
निकट दृष्टि: Short-sightedness is unrelated

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the pulse and blood pressure before giving a beta blocker and withhold it if too low, as per orders

question:
Intravenous potassium chloride must always be:

अंतःशिरा पोटैशियम क्लोराइड सदैव कैसे दिया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Diluted and given slowly, never as a bolus
तनु करके धीरे-धीरे, कभी बोलस के रूप में नहीं

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Concentrated potassium can stop the heart, so it is always diluted and given slowly

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Given undiluted
बिना तनु किए: Undiluted potassium is extremely dangerous

B — Given as a rapid bolus
तेज़ बोलस के रूप में: A bolus can cause fatal arrhythmia

C — Given quickly to save time
समय बचाने के लिए जल्दी: A fast rate can cause cardiac arrest

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Use a pump or careful monitoring during potassium infusion and check the infusion site often
option_2:
Given as a rapid bolus
तेज़ बोलस के रूप में
option_3:
Given quickly to save time
समय बचाने के लिए जल्दी
option_4:
Diluted and given slowly, never as a bolus
तनु करके धीरे-धीरे, कभी बोलस के रूप में नहीं

question:
A patient on long-term corticosteroids should be taught to:

दीर्घकालिक कॉर्टिकोस्टेरॉइड पर रोगी को क्या सिखाया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Never stop the drug suddenly and take it with food
दवा अचानक बंद न करें और इसे भोजन के साथ लें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Steroids are tapered, never stopped suddenly, and are taken with food to protect the stomach

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Stop the drug as soon as symptoms improve
लक्षण सुधरते ही दवा बंद कर दें: Sudden stopping can cause adrenal crisis

C — Take it on an empty stomach only
केवल खाली पेट लें: Taking with food reduces stomach upset

D — Double the dose when feeling better
ठीक लगने पर खुराक दोगुनी करें: Doubling the dose is dangerous

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Long-term steroids need monitoring for infection, high blood sugar and bone weakness
option_1:
Stop the drug as soon as symptoms improve
लक्षण सुधरते ही दवा बंद कर दें
option_2:
Never stop the drug suddenly and take it with food
दवा अचानक बंद न करें और इसे भोजन के साथ लें
option_3:
Take it on an empty stomach only
केवल खाली पेट लें
option_4:
Double the dose when feeling better
ठीक लगने पर खुराक दोगुनी करें

question:
The best way to prevent waterborne disease in a village is to:

गाँव में जलजनित रोग से बचाव का सबसे अच्छा तरीका क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Use safe drinking water and improve sanitation
सुरक्षित पेयजल का उपयोग करें और स्वच्छता सुधारें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Safe water and good sanitation prevent waterborne disease

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Store water in open pots
पानी को खुले बर्तनों में रखें: Open storage allows contamination

C — Defecate near water sources
जल स्रोतों के पास शौच करें: Defecation near water sources contaminates them

D — Drink untreated stream water
बिना उपचारित नदी का पानी पिएँ: Untreated water carries organisms

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Boiling, filtering or chlorinating water reduces the risk of diarrhoeal disease
option_1:
Use safe drinking water and improve sanitation
सुरक्षित पेयजल का उपयोग करें और स्वच्छता सुधारें
option_2:
Store water in open pots
पानी को खुले बर्तनों में रखें
option_3:
Defecate near water sources
जल स्रोतों के पास शौच करें
option_4:
Drink untreated stream water
बिना उपचारित नदी का पानी पिएँ

question:
The main aim of a school health programme is to:

विद्यालय स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रम का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Promote health and detect problems early in school children
विद्यालयी बच्चों में स्वास्थ्य को बढ़ावा देना और समस्याओं का शीघ्र पता लगाना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: School health programmes promote health and detect problems early

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Increase the school fees
विद्यालय की फ़ीस बढ़ाना: Fees are unrelated to health

B — Reduce the number of teachers
शिक्षकों की संख्या घटाना: Reducing teachers does not improve health

D — Replace classroom teaching
कक्षा शिक्षण को बदलना: It supports, not replaces, teaching

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Periodic health checks, immunisation and health education are key parts of school health
option_1:
Increase the school fees
विद्यालय की फ़ीस बढ़ाना
option_2:
Reduce the number of teachers
शिक्षकों की संख्या घटाना
option_3:
Promote health and detect problems early in school children
विद्यालयी बच्चों में स्वास्थ्य को बढ़ावा देना और समस्याओं का शीघ्र पता लगाना

question:
During a community camp, a middle-aged man has a blood pressure of 160/100 mmHg and no symptoms. The nurse should:

समुदाय शिविर में एक मध्यम आयु के पुरुष का रक्तचाप 160/100 mmHg है और कोई लक्षण नहीं है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Repeat the reading, advise follow-up and counsel on risk factors
रीडिंग दोहराएँ, अनुवर्ती जाँच की सलाह दें और जोखिम कारकों पर परामर्श दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A high reading is confirmed, follow-up is advised and risk factors are addressed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Advise smoking to relax
आराम के लिए धूम्रपान की सलाह दें: Smoking is harmful

B — Reassure that no action is needed
कहें कि कोई कार्रवाई आवश्यक नहीं: An untreated high blood pressure damages organs silently

D — Tell him to eat more salt
उसे अधिक नमक खाने को कहें: More salt raises blood pressure

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Screening detects high blood pressure early, before complications such as stroke occur
option_1:
Advise smoking to relax
आराम के लिए धूम्रपान की सलाह दें
option_2:
Reassure that no action is needed
कहें कि कोई कार्रवाई आवश्यक नहीं
option_3:
Repeat the reading, advise follow-up and counsel on risk factors
रीडिंग दोहराएँ, अनुवर्ती जाँच की सलाह दें और जोखिम कारकों पर परामर्श दें
option_4:
Tell him to eat more salt
उसे अधिक नमक खाने को कहें

question:
In mass-casualty triage, the nurse gives priority to:

सामूहिक आपदा ट्रायाज में नर्स किसे प्राथमिकता देती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Casualties who need immediate life-saving care and can be saved
उन घायलों को जिन्हें तत्काल जीवन-रक्षक देखभाल चाहिए और जिन्हें बचाया जा सकता है

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Triage aims to save the most lives by treating those who need urgent, salvageable care first

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — The wealthiest casualties first
पहले सबसे अमीर घायलों को: Priority is based on clinical need, not wealth

C — Only those with minor injuries
केवल हल्की चोट वालों को: Minor injuries can wait

D — Casualties who are already dead
उन घायलों को जो पहले ही मर चुके हैं: The deceased are not treated in triage

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Triage also happens when a single ward receives many patients at once
option_1:
The wealthiest casualties first
पहले सबसे अमीर घायलों को
option_2:
Casualties who need immediate life-saving care and can be saved
उन घायलों को जिन्हें तत्काल जीवन-रक्षक देखभाल चाहिए और जिन्हें बचाया जा सकता है
option_3:
Only those with minor injuries
केवल हल्की चोट वालों को
option_4:
Casualties who are already dead
उन घायलों को जो पहले ही मर चुके हैं

question:
To reduce maternal deaths, the nurse should emphasise:

मातृ मृत्यु कम करने के लिए नर्स को किस पर ज़ोर देना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Early registration of pregnancy and regular antenatal check-ups
गर्भावस्था का शीघ्र पंजीकरण और नियमित प्रसवपूर्व जाँचें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Early registration and regular check-ups detect danger signs in time

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Home delivery without trained help
बिना प्रशिक्षित सहायता के घर पर प्रसव: Untrained home delivery raises the risk of death

B — Avoiding all check-ups
सारी जाँचों से बचना: Avoiding check-ups misses early warning signs

D — Delaying delivery care
प्रसव देखभाल में देरी: Delay in care worsens outcomes

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Refer high-risk women to a facility early, before an emergency arises
option_1:
Home delivery without trained help
बिना प्रशिक्षित सहायता के घर पर प्रसव
option_3:
Early registration of pregnancy and regular antenatal check-ups
गर्भावस्था का शीघ्र पंजीकरण और नियमित प्रसवपूर्व जाँचें

question:
A child who misses a scheduled vaccine dose should:

निर्धारित टीके की खुराक चूकने वाले बच्चे को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Receive the missed dose as soon as possible
छूटी हुई खुराक जल्द से जल्द लें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A missed dose is given as soon as possible without restarting the schedule

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Skip the vaccine permanently
वह टीका स्थायी रूप से छोड़ दें: Skipping leaves a gap in protection

C — Wait for one full year
पूरे एक वर्ष प्रतीक्षा करें: Waiting a year leaves the child unprotected

D — Restart the entire schedule
पूरा कार्यक्रम फिर से शुरू करें: The schedule is continued, not restarted

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Maintaining the immunisation card helps track and complete all doses
option_1:
Skip the vaccine permanently
वह टीका स्थायी रूप से छोड़ दें
option_2:
Receive the missed dose as soon as possible
छूटी हुई खुराक जल्द से जल्द लें
option_3:
Wait for one full year
पूरे एक वर्ष प्रतीक्षा करें
option_4:
Restart the entire schedule
पूरा कार्यक्रम फिर से शुरू करें

question:
A newborn has cold hands and feet with a temperature of 35.5 degrees Celsius. The nurse should:

नवजात के हाथ-पैर ठंडे हैं और तापमान 35.5 डिग्री सेल्सियस है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Warm the baby by skin-to-skin contact and cover the head
त्वचा-से-त्वचा संपर्क से शिशु को गर्म करें और सिर ढकें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Skin-to-skin contact and covering the head warm the baby safely

🔍 Key Clues: newborn | 35.5 degrees Celsius

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give a cold bath
ठंडा स्नान कराएँ: A cold bath worsens hypothermia

C — Keep the baby uncovered
शिशु को बिना ढका रखें: Leaving the baby uncovered loses more heat

D — Delay warming until the next round
अगले राउंड तक गर्म करने में देरी करें: Delay can lead to complications

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Hypothermia increases the risk of infection and poor feeding, so keep the baby warm from birth
option_2:
Warm the baby by skin-to-skin contact and cover the head
त्वचा-से-त्वचा संपर्क से शिशु को गर्म करें और सिर ढकें
option_3:
Keep the baby uncovered
शिशु को बिना ढका रखें
option_4:
Delay warming until the next round
अगले राउंड तक गर्म करने में देरी करें

question:
A child with pneumonia should be watched for:

निमोनिया वाले बच्चे की किस चीज़ के लिए निगरानी की जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Fast breathing and chest indrawing
तेज़ श्वास और छाती का धँसना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Fast breathing and chest indrawing are danger signs in childhood pneumonia

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Loud laughter
तेज़ हँसी: Laughter is not a danger sign

C — Increased appetite
भूख बढ़ना: Appetite usually falls in a sick child

D — Rapid weight gain
तेज़ वज़न बढ़ना: Rapid weight gain is unrelated

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Danger signs mean the child needs urgent referral and treatment
option_1:
Fast breathing and chest indrawing
तेज़ श्वास और छाती का धँसना

question:
A young child is very thin, has oedema of the feet and a poor appetite. The nurse should suspect:

एक छोटा बच्चा बहुत दुबला है, पैरों में सूजन है और भूख कम है। नर्स को किसका संदेह करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Severe acute malnutrition
गंभीर तीव्र कुपोषण

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Oedema with severe wasting and a poor appetite suggests severe acute malnutrition

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Simple obesity
साधारण मोटापा: Obesity is the opposite of wasting

C — Normal growth
सामान्य वृद्धि: This is not normal growth

D — Overfeeding
अति-भोजन: Overfeeding does not cause wasting with oedema

question:

question:

question:

question:

शृंखला पूरी करें: 2, 6, 10, 14, ?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 18
18

🧠 Method: Each term increases by 4, so the next term is 18

⚡ Fast Approach: Check the differences first, then squares, cubes or multiplication.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 22
22: 22 would need a step of 8

C — 16
16: 16 would need a step of 2

D — 20
20: 20 would need a step of 6

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Recognising constant differences speeds up series questions

question:
Select the figure that is different from the other three:

उस आकृति को चुनें जो अन्य तीन से भिन्न है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Cube
घन

🧠 Method: A cube is a three-dimensional shape, while the others are two-dimensional

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the circles of the given sets and see which conclusion is certain.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Triangle
त्रिभुज: A triangle is a plane figure

B — Square
वर्ग: A square is a plane figure

D — Circle
वृत्त: A circle is a plane figure

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Classification questions test observation of properties

question:

शृंखला पूरी करें: A, C, E, G, ?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. I
I

🧠 Method: Each letter moves two steps forward, so after G comes I

⚡ Fast Approach: Number the letters A=1 to Z=26 and work with numbers instead of letters.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — H
H: H is one step after G

B — K
K: K is four steps after G

C — J
J: J is three steps after G

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Letter-series practice improves speed in reasoning sections

question:
Pointing to a man, a woman says he is the son of my father. The man is her:

एक पुरुष की ओर इशारा करते हुए महिला कहती है कि वह मेरे पिता का पुत्र है। वह पुरुष उसका क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Brother
भाई

🧠 Method: The son of her father is her brother

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the family tree and mark the given relations before answering.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Uncle
चाचा: An uncle would be the father's brother

C — Son
पुत्र: A son would be her own child

D — Father
पिता: Her father is the man's father, not the man

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Blood-relation puzzles build careful logical reasoning

question:
A person facing south turns left. The person is now facing:

दक्षिण की ओर मुँह किए व्यक्ति बाईं ओर मुड़ता है। अब वह किस दिशा में मुँह किए है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. East
पूर्व

🧠 Method: Facing south, a left turn leads to east

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw a small diagram - each turn changes the direction by a fixed angle.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — North
उत्तर: North is directly opposite

B — West
पश्चिम: West would be a right turn from south

D — South
दक्षिण: South is the starting direction

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Direction questions are solved by drawing a simple compass

question:
At 3 o'clock, the angle between the hands of a clock is:

3 बजे घड़ी की सुइयों के बीच का कोण कितना होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. 90 degrees
90 डिग्री

🧠 Method: Each hour is 30 degrees, so at 3 o'clock the hands are 90 degrees apart

⚡ Fast Approach: Use the remainder after dividing by 7 for days, and 30 degrees per hour for clocks.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — 30 degrees
30 डिग्री: 30 degrees is the gap for one hour

C — 60 degrees
60 डिग्री: 60 degrees would be 2 o'clock

D — 120 degrees
120 डिग्री: 120 degrees would be 4 o'clock

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Clock questions test careful angle reasoning
